# Huruma Children's Trust Canada

> Registered Canadian charity (Collingwood, Ontario) supporting Huruma Children's Home & School in Ngong, Kenya. CRA charity number 830771770RR0001.

This charity raises funds from donors across Canada. It is separate from Huruma Trust Fund in Kenya, which operates the home locally.

## Site
- English home: https://hurumachildrenstrustcanada.org/
- French home: https://hurumachildrenstrustcanada.org/fr/
- Donate: https://hurumachildrenstrustcanada.org/donate.html
- Costs: https://hurumachildrenstrustcanada.org/donation-costs.html
- Mama's Health: https://hurumachildrenstrustcanada.org/mamas-health.html
- Board reports: https://hurumachildrenstrustcanada.org/reports.html
